scenario.name: Second dust during a power-up
scenario.heading: N
scenario.expected: Clean is Power Up from tick 3 (dust at (4,6)). At tick 5 it is on the second dust cell (4,4) and the 5 ticks start again (C10), so Clean stays Power Up through tick 8. At tick 9 the top wall is in front: it stops and Clean is Stop, with 1 power-up tick left. After the stop (ticks 9-13) and the right turn (ticks 14-18) it goes forward with Clean Power Up at tick 19 (C11) and Clean Start from tick 20.
